name: Ostffyasszonyfa (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, white at the hoist and blue at the fly, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Ostffyasszonyfa (a blue and red shield with a wing and stars) above the name OSTFFYASSZONYFA in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
